name: Audit: URL
description: Analyzes URL aliases and redirects (loops, collisions, broken targets, route shadowing). Path Alias and Redirect modules are detected at runtime; only applicable groups are checked.
project_description: audit_url registers the `url` AuditAnalyzer plugin (UrlAnalyzer). It detects the core Path Alias and contrib Redirect modules at runtime and only runs the applicable check groups. It analyzes redirect chains/loops, broken or non-resolving redirect targets, alias collisions (two aliases resolving to conflicting system paths), and aliases that shadow real routes. Findings are grouped into scored sections plus an informational overview. Ships no config of its own; warns if neither Redirect nor Path Alias is enabled.
